fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (MU) is expected to reflect HBM price increases in 2027 at December earnings announcement; CEO noted '2027 will be much better than 2026.'
fields.summary_ko.1: Nvidia CFO remarks suggest imminent memory supply-demand improvement, with Micron's HBM4 chip valued as high-margin product in the high-bandwidth memory market.
